full_judgment:
Mirza Hussain Haider J. This Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal is directed against the Judgment and order dated 11.05.2016, passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Rule No.90 (Con-A) of 2016 discharging the Rule and consequently dismissing the appeal as being barred by limitation. 

 5. A Division Bench of the High Court Division, after hearing the parties and on perusal of the materials on record, dis-charged the Rule and dismissed the appeal as being barred by limitation by the judgment and order dated 11.05.2016. Against the same the petitioner filed the instant criminal petition for leave to appeal.
